name: Verde Pipeline (EOG / Pecan Pipeline)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Pecan Pipeline; South Texas Dorado - Verde Pipeline

researcher_notes: No existing row matches (checked the 529-row US gas roster for Verde, Dorado, Pecan, EOG, Webb and Duval). Passes the add-threshold: sponsor is Pecan Pipeline Co, a wholly owned EOG Resources subsidiary; endpoints are Webb County to Duval County, Texas; the pipeline is built. EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 1115: New Pipeline, Completed, in service 2024-09, 41.66 mi, 36 in, 1,000 MMcf/d, intrastate, notes say phase 1 done in 2023 and phase 2 in the second half of 2024, ending at the Agua Dulce hub area. An Oil Gas Leads post from July 2022 reports the Texas permit approval for a 41 mile line in Webb and Duval Counties. Length 41.66 mi is well above the 15.5 mi floor. Those two sources are weakly independent: EIA is one origin and the news post is a permit-based summary, so tier is medium. The EIA row and the post agree on the owner, the county pair and the length. Not found: a Texas Railroad Commission T-4 permit page and a diameter in any second source. The line is intrastate, so FERC silence is expected. Exact start and end points are not stated, only the counties. No route found, so RouteType is Unavailable and a human route search could use the RRC pipeline map. Owner spelling follows the entity style tool (rules match, medium). Parent spelling EOG Resources Inc adopted from the gazetteer stem match, so confirm. FIDStatus left blank.
